paragraphs.text: The following walks have coloured marker posts to guide you
paragraphs.translation: 以下步行路线设有彩色标记柱，用于为您指引方向

paragraphs.text: A Grove Mill
paragraphs.translation: A 格罗夫磨坊

paragraphs.text: Take either the yellow path or the blue path - both eventually come out at the old Water Mill and are at about the same level of difficulty. There is a shallow stream which runs alongside the yellow path. Dogs enjoy a swim here if it's hot, and there are trees to help keep you cool while you wait.
paragraphs.translation:
您可以走黄色路径或蓝色路径——两者最终都会抵达古老的水磨坊，并且难度大致相当。
黄色路径旁有一条浅浅的小溪流过。
天气炎热时，狗喜欢在这里游泳，而周围的树木也能让您在等待时保持凉爽。

paragraphs.text: B Blackhill Trail
paragraphs.translation: B 布莱克希尔步道

paragraphs.text: Follow the marker posts carefully as you make your way through some dense forest. lf you take a wrong turn, as walkers often do, your walk could end up being a lot longer than you expected.The sun may be shining, but there is plenty of damp undergrowth, so wear a tough pair of hiking boots if you don't want your feet to get wet. It isn't advisable to take small dogs on this trail.
paragraphs.translation:
当你穿越一片茂密的森林时，请小心跟随标记柱。
如果你像徒步者常做的那样拐错弯，你的徒步可能会变得比预期长得多。
阳光可能很明媚，但地面有许多潮湿的低矮灌木，所以如果你不想弄湿双脚，就穿一双结实的登山靴。
不建议在这条小路上带小狗。

paragraphs.text: C Fern way
paragraphs.translation: C 蕨类小径

paragraphs.text: The route is winding but fairly flat and doesn't require any special footwear or equipment. It is accessed by a gate with a strong bolt to keep sheep and cows in the field.The path is lined on both sides by firs and some majestic redwoods that date back to the nineteenth century. There are benches along the way,where you can rest and admire the beauty of the area.
paragraphs.translation:
这条路蜿蜒曲折但相当平坦，不需要任何特殊鞋类或装备。
入口处有一扇带坚固门闩的大门，用于将羊和牛圈在田野里。
小路两侧种满了冷杉和一些可追溯到19世纪的宏伟红杉。
沿途设有长椅，您可以在此休息并欣赏该地区的美景。

paragraphs.text: D Bay Red Valley
paragraphs.translation: D 湾红河谷

paragraphs.text: Be prepared to go up and down a bit on this route.The first section is uphill,then the path flattens out- but not for long, so you need to be fairly fit. The exercise is worth it, though, as there are some spectacular views across the valley. There is a viewing platform, from which you may be lucky enough to see one of the herds of deer that roam the area.
paragraphs.translation:
做好准备，这条路线会有一些上下起伏。
第一段是上坡，然后小路变得平坦——但不会持续太久，因此你需要相当好的体能。
不过，这番努力是值得的，因为可以欣赏到山谷对面的壮丽景色。
有一个观景台，你也许会幸运地看到一群在该地区漫步的鹿。

paragraphs.text: E Brownwater Trail
paragraphs.translation: E 布朗沃特小径

paragraphs.text: A circular path will take you past tree and plant species from around the world that are cared for by a dedicated team of volunteers. If you bring your dog,keep it on a lead as the smaller shrubs can be easily destroyed.The path itself is open and unprotected, so be sure to wear a hat or you could get sunburnt.
paragraphs.translation:
一条环形路径将带你经过来自世界各地的树木和植物物种，这些植物由一个专注的志愿者团队照料。
如果你带狗来，请用绳子牵着它，因为较小的灌木很容易被破坏。
这条路径本身是开阔且无遮挡的，所以一定要戴帽子，否则你可能会被晒伤。

paragraphs.text: Poppi Properties
paragraphs.translation: 波比地产

paragraphs.text: Review by Sally Hanugoldi
paragraphs.translation: 莎莉·哈努戈尔迪的评论

paragraphs.text: l have had a terrible experience with Poppi Properties and as an ex-tenant, I advise you to go elsewhere if you want to rent or buy a property - as I have now done.When I initially viewed my Poppi Properties flat, I was accompanied by Lillee Eggerton, one of the two staff who run the company. The flat was located close to the office where I have been working for the past year, so I went there before the working day had begun. I knew immediately that it was the right property for me because of the convenient location, and a few days later I paid the deposit and the first two months' rent. The flat was on the 12th floor, which I admit was a surprise to me as I thought it was lower when I first read about it, but Lillee was very encouraging, and l felt confident that I was making the right choice.At this point, she was professional and kind, but once I had moved into the property, I discovered that she was far less approachable than she had been during the viewing period and whenever I tried to contact her, she was unavailable.
paragraphs.translation:
波比地产
我对Poppi Properties公司有过糟糕的经历，作为前租户，我建议如果你想租房或买房，就去别处看看——就像我现在已经做的那样。
当我初次看Poppi Properties的公寓时，是由该公司的两名员工之一Lillee Eggerton陪同的。
这套公寓位于过去一年我工作的办公室附近，所以我在工作日开始前去了那里。
因为位置便利，我立刻知道这处房产适合我，几天后我支付了押金和头两个月的租金。
公寓在12楼，我承认这让我感到意外，因为我最初看到介绍时以为楼层更低，但Lillee非常鼓励我，我相信自己做出了正确的选择。
那时，她专业且友善，但一旦我搬进这处房产，我发现她远不如看房期间那么平易近人，而且每当我试图联系她时，她都不在。

paragraphs.text: At the start of my tenancy, a number of issues were unsatisfactory in the property.For example, as a new tenant, you have a right to expect your flat to be clean. In fact,carpets should be professionally cleaned, but mine had not even been hoovered. I had hoped that this problem would be addressed quickly, but nothing happened and so I did the job myself. Similarly, the oven worked when I switched it on,but it was black inside and smelt horrible.The company did nothing, so in the end I just avoided using the oven while I lived there. Several times, I asked to speak to the landlord directly but was told this was not possible. No one should have to put up with these problems, particularly when Poppi Properties charge such high rents!
paragraphs.translation:
波比地产
在我租期刚开始时，房产中存在一些令人不满意的问题。
例如，作为新租户，你有权期望你的公寓是干净的。
事实上，地毯本应由专业人员进行清洁，但我住的地毯甚至没有被吸尘器吸过。
我曾希望这个问题能很快得到解决，但没有任何进展，于是我自己动手做了这项工作。
同样地，烤箱打开时能正常工作，但内部是黑色的，而且气味难闻。
公司没有采取任何措施，所以我最终在居住期间避免使用这个烤箱。
有几次，我要求直接与房东谈话，但被告知这是不可能的。
没有人应该忍受这些问题，尤其是当Poppi Properties收取如此高昂的租金时！

questions.location_analysis: E段路径开阔无遮蔽，易晒伤，符合'很少阴凉'。

evidence: The path itself is open and unprotected, so be sure to wear a hat or you could get sunburnt.

questions.prompt: There are some steep sections.

questions.reason: 对应题目There are some steep sections.

questions.prompt: There is a choice of route on this walk.

questions.reason: A段明确给出两条可选路线
questions.location_analysis: A段提供黄蓝两条路径可选，对应'有路线选择'。
questions.paraphrasing: choice of route -> either the yellow path or the blue path
evidence: Take either the yellow path or the blue path - both eventually come out at the old Water Mill and are at about the same level of difficulty.

questions.prompt: There is a special site for watching wildlife.
questions.analysis: 题干中的“special site for watching wildlife”对应D段提到的“There is a viewing platform, from which you may be lucky enough to see one of the herds of deer”，观景台专为观赏鹿群（野生动物）而设，因此答案为D。
questions.reason: D段明确提供观看野生动物的平台
questions.location_analysis: D段观景台可看鹿群，对应'特别野生动物观察点'。
questions.paraphrasing: watching wildlife -> see one of the herds of deer
evidence: There is a viewing platform, from which you may be lucky enough to see one of the herds of deer that roam the area.

questions.prompt: Dogs must not be allowed to run freely.
questions.analysis: 题干中的“Dogs must not be allowed to run freely”对应E段“If you bring your dog, keep it on a lead”，要求狗必须拴绳，以防破坏灌木，即不能自由奔跑，因此答案为E。
questions.reason: 题干'dogs must not be allowed to run freely'对应keep on a lead。
questions.location_analysis: 原文要求狗必须拴绳，不能自由奔跑。
questions.paraphrasing: not allowed to run freely -> keep it on a lead
questions.keywords: dogs, not run freely, keep on a lead
evidence: If you bring your dog,keep it on a lead as the smaller shrubs can be easily destroyed.

questions.prompt: You can sit down in several places.
questions.analysis: 题干中的“sit down in several places”对应C段“There are benches along the way, where you can rest”，说明沿途设有多个长椅供休息，符合“多处可坐”的描述，因此答案为C。
questions.reason: C段明确提到沿途有长椅，与题干相符。
questions.location_analysis: C段沿途有长椅可供休息，对应多处可坐。
questions.paraphrasing: sit down in several places -> benches along the way
questions.keywords: sit down, several places, benches along the way
evidence: There are benches along the way,where you can rest and admire the beauty of the area.

sentence_translations.sentence: If you bring your dog, keep it on a lead as the smaller shrubs can be easily destroyed.
sentence_translations.translation: 如果你带狗来，请用绳子牵着它，因为较小的灌木很容易被破坏。

sentence_translations.sentence: The path itself is open and unprotected, so be sure to wear a hat or you could get sunburnt.
sentence_translations.translation: 这条路径本身是开阔且无遮挡的，所以一定要戴帽子，否则你可能会被晒伤。

sentence_translations.sentence: Poppi Properties
sentence_translations.translation: 波比地产

sentence_translations.sentence: Review by Sally Hanugoldi
sentence_translations.translation: 莎莉·哈努戈尔迪的评论

sentence_translations.sentence: l have had a terrible experience with Poppi Properties and as an ex-tenant, I advise you to go elsewhere if you want to rent or buy a property - as I have now done.
sentence_translations.translation: 我对Poppi Properties公司有过糟糕的经历，作为前租户，我建议如果你想租房或买房，就去别处看看——就像我现在已经做的那样。

sentence_translations.sentence: When I initially viewed my Poppi Properties flat, I was accompanied by Lillee Eggerton, one of the two staff who run the company.
sentence_translations.translation: 当我初次看Poppi Properties的公寓时，是由该公司的两名员工之一Lillee Eggerton陪同的。

sentence_translations.sentence: The flat was located close to the office where I have been working for the past year, so I went there before the working day had begun.
sentence_translations.translation: 这套公寓位于过去一年我工作的办公室附近，所以我在工作日开始前去了那里。

sentence_translations.sentence: I knew immediately that it was the right property for me because of the convenient location, and a few days later I paid the deposit and the first two months' rent.
sentence_translations.translation: 因为位置便利，我立刻知道这处房产适合我，几天后我支付了押金和头两个月的租金。

sentence_translations.sentence: The flat was on the 12th floor, which I admit was a surprise to me as I thought it was lower when I first read about it, but Lillee was very encouraging, and l felt confident that I was making the right choice.
sentence_translations.translation: 公寓在12楼，我承认这让我感到意外，因为我最初看到介绍时以为楼层更低，但Lillee非常鼓励我，我相信自己做出了正确的选择。

sentence_translations.sentence: At this point, she was professional and kind, but once I had moved into the property, I discovered that she was far less approachable than she had been during the viewing period and whenever I tried to contact her, she was unavailable.
sentence_translations.translation: 那时，她专业且友善，但一旦我搬进这处房产，我发现她远不如看房期间那么平易近人，而且每当我试图联系她时，她都不在。

sentence_translations.sentence: At the start of my tenancy, a number of issues were unsatisfactory in the property.
sentence_translations.translation: 在我租期刚开始时，房产中存在一些令人不满意的问题。

sentence_translations.sentence: For example, as a new tenant, you have a right to expect your flat to be clean.
sentence_translations.translation: 例如，作为新租户，你有权期望你的公寓是干净的。

sentence_translations.sentence: In fact, carpets should be professionally cleaned, but mine had not even been hoovered.
sentence_translations.translation: 事实上，地毯本应由专业人员进行清洁，但我住的地毯甚至没有被吸尘器吸过。

sentence_translations.sentence: I had hoped that this problem would be addressed quickly, but nothing happened and so I did the job myself.
sentence_translations.translation: 我曾希望这个问题能很快得到解决，但没有任何进展，于是我自己动手做了这项工作。

sentence_translations.sentence: Similarly, the oven worked when I switched it on, but it was black inside and smelt horrible.
sentence_translations.translation: 同样地，烤箱打开时能正常工作，但内部是黑色的，而且气味难闻。

sentence_translations.sentence: The company did nothing, so in the end I just avoided using the oven while I lived there.
sentence_translations.translation: 公司没有采取任何措施，所以我最终在居住期间避免使用这个烤箱。

sentence_translations.sentence: Several times, I asked to speak to the landlord directly but was told this was not possible.
sentence_translations.translation: 有几次，我要求直接与房东谈话，但被告知这是不可能的。

sentence_translations.sentence: No one should have to put up with these problems, particularly when Poppi Properties charge such high rents!
sentence_translations.translation: 没有人应该忍受这些问题，尤其是当Poppi Properties收取如此高昂的租金时！

parts.title: Passage 2
parts.article_title: Procedure for making a complaint at work

paragraphs.text: If you have a problem or complaint at work, you might want to take this up with your employer. This is called 'raising a grievance'.
paragraphs.translation:
如果你在工作中遇到问题或提出投诉，你可能希望与雇主讨论此事。
这被称为“提出申诉”。

paragraphs.text: Often the best way to sort out a problem is to request an informal meeting with your immediate manager to explain your concerns. You may find it is possible to sort the problem out in this way without having to take any further action.However, if you do not feel your problem has been solved,you may decide to raise a formal grievance. In this case you should first try to find out your company's grievance procedure. You should be able to find details of this in your Company Handbook, HR or Personnel manual, or on your company's HR intranet site.
paragraphs.translation:
通常，解决问题的最佳方式是请求与直属经理进行非正式会议，以解释你的担忧。
你可能会发现，通过这种方式解决问题是可行的，无需采取进一步行动。
然而，如果你觉得问题没有得到解决，你可以决定提出正式申诉。
在这种情况下，你应首先尝试了解公司的申诉程序。
你应能在公司手册、人力资源或人事手册中，或是公司的人力资源内网上找到相关细节。

paragraphs.text: The next step will probably be to write to your employer. Explain your problem, and if you can think of a possible solution for resolving it, give details of this. When you have written your letter, check that you have written the date, and retain a copy so that you have a record of what you wrote. Your employer should arrange an initial meeting at a reasonable time and place to discuss your grievance.You are entitled to ask either a colleague from work or a trade union representative to go to the meeting with you. After the meeting, your employer should write to you, telling you what they have decided to do about your grievance.
paragraphs.translation:
下一步可能是写信给你的雇主。
解释你的问题，如果你能想到可能的解决方案，请详细说明。
写完信后，检查是否写上了日期，并保留一份副本，以便你有记录自己写的内容。
你的雇主应安排一次初次会议，在合理的时间和地点讨论你的申诉。
你有权邀请一位同事或工会代表与你一同参加会议。
会议结束后，你的雇主应写信给你，告知他们针对你的申诉所做的决定。

paragraphs.text: If you don't agree with your employer's decision, you have the right to appeal against it. This must be done in writing. A further meeting should then be called, which should be led by a more senior manager if possible. If you are still not satisfied with the decision made at this meeting, you may consider whether one way to solve the problem might be through mediation.This may be done inside the company or by an external agent. Alternatively, you can make an employment tribunal claim.You must do this no more than three months after the time when the event you are complaining about happened. If your application is received after this time limit, the tribunal will not usually accept it.
paragraphs.translation:
如果您不同意雇主的决定，您有权对此提出申诉。
这必须以书面形式进行。
随后应召集一次进一步的会议，如果可能的话，应由更高级别的经理主持。
如果您仍然对本次会议做出的决定不满意，您可以考虑通过调解来解决问题是否是一个途径。
这可以在公司内部进行，也可以通过外部机构进行。
或者，您可以向就业法庭提出索赔。
您必须在所投诉事件发生后的三个月内提出。
如果您的申请在此时间限制之后才被收到，法庭通常不会予以受理。

paragraphs.text: Driving a taxi or private hire vehicle
paragraphs.translation: 驾驶出租车或私人租用车辆

paragraphs.text: Taxis are an important part of any town or city's transport system. Taxis have a licence plate and roof sign that states they are a taxi.As a taxi driver, you might be booked in advance, wait on a taxi rank or pick up passengers while on the move. You could combine normal 'pick-up' jobs with prearranged contracts such as regular trips for schoolchildren or those unable to drive. You might also make longer-distance trips such as taking people to airports. The other type of passenger transport is a private hire vehicle.As a private hire driver, you can only collect passengers who have pre-booked through your operator. You cannot be flagged down in the street.
paragraphs.translation:
出租车是任何城镇或城市交通系统的重要组成部分。
出租车有牌照和顶灯，表明它们是出租车。
作为一名出租车司机，你可能会被提前预订、在出租车站等候或在行驶中接载乘客。
你可以将常规的‘接载’工作与预先安排的合同（例如为学生或无法驾驶的人提供定期行程）结合起来。
你也可能进行长途行程，例如送人们去机场。
另一种类型的客运是私人租赁车辆。
作为一名私人租赁司机，你只能接载通过你的运营商预先预订的乘客。
你不能在街上被挥手拦车。

paragraphs.text: When working in a taxi or private hire vehicle, you would:
paragraphs.translation: 当您在出租车或私人租赁车辆中工作时，您将：

paragraphs.text: • take job details over the radio from the operator at the office or by an in-car computer
paragraphs.translation: • 通过办公室调度员的无线电或车载电脑接收工作详情

paragraphs.text: • help to load and unload passengers' luggage
paragraphs.translation: • 协助装卸乘客的行李

paragraphs.text: • assist passengers with any physical conditions that make it difficult for them to get in and out of the vehicle
paragraphs.translation: • 帮助那些因身体状况而难以进出车辆的乘客

paragraphs.text: • take payments
paragraphs.translation: • 收取费用

paragraphs.text: • keep the vehicle clean and roadworthy
paragraphs.translation: • 保持车辆清洁并处于适航状态

paragraphs.text: • keep accounts and records, if self-employed.
paragraphs.translation: • 如果你是个体经营者，需要保留账目和记录。

paragraphs.text: Working conditions and skills
paragraphs.translation: 工作条件与技能

paragraphs.text: You would spend most of your time on the road, sometimes in heavy traffic, and you would be constantly on the move.The job allows you to choose your hours, but you will find more work in the evenings. You would work between 40 and 60 hours a week if full time. In the UK,17% of taxi drivers are employed full time,17% are employed part time and 66% are self-employed.As well as being a skilled driver, you need to be good at communicating with people and helping customers. You must be tactful when dealing with problems and have good time management and numeracy skills.
paragraphs.translation:
大部分时间你都会在路上，有时会遭遇交通拥堵，并且你会持续处于移动状态。
这份工作允许你自由选择工作时间，但你会发现晚上工作量更大。
如果全职工作，你每周需要工作40到60小时。
在英国，17%的出租车司机全职受雇，17%兼职受雇，而66%是自雇人士。
除了是一名熟练的司机外，你还需要善于与人沟通并帮助顾客。
处理问题时你必须机智得体，并具备良好的时间管理和计算能力。

paragraphs.text: Requirements
paragraphs.translation: 要求

paragraphs.text: You will need a special licence from your local authority to be a taxi driver or private car hire driver. For this, you usually need to be over 21 years old, to have a clean current driving licence and to have been driving for at least 12 months. You may also need to pass a test of knowledge about the local geography. If you are using your own vehicle, it will also need a special licence.
paragraphs.translation:
要成为一名出租车司机或私人租车司机，你需要从当地政府获得特殊执照。
为此，你通常需要年满21周岁，持有有效的无违章记录驾驶执照，并且驾龄至少满12个月。
你可能还需要通过一项关于当地地理知识的测试。
如果你使用自己的车辆，它也需要获得特殊执照。

paragraphs.text: Many employers value additional driver training which could include the Advanced Driving Test offered by the Institute of Advanced Motorists. Evidence of basic mechanical skills, such as RQF level 4, would also be welcome.
paragraphs.translation:
许多雇主重视额外的驾驶员培训，这可能包括由高级驾驶员协会提供的进阶驾驶考试。
具备基本机械技能的证据（例如 RQF 4 级资格）也将受到欢迎。

questions.prompt: Your employer should then arrange a further meeting. Where possible, this should be led by a manager who is _____ to the previous one.

questions.analysis: 题干中的“think about the possibility of ___”对应原文第四段“you may consider whether one way to solve the problem might be through mediation”。“mediation”是文中明确提出的一种解决方式，因此答案为“mediation”。
questions.reason: 题干think about possibility对应原文consider...通过mediation。
questions.location_analysis: 原文提到through mediation作为可能方案。
questions.paraphrasing: possibility of mediation -> problem might be through mediation
evidence: If you are still not satisfied with the decision made at this meeting, you may consider whether one way to solve the problem might be through mediation.

questions.prompt: · make an employment tribunal claim. This must be done within _____ months of the date of the event.
questions.analysis: 题干要求填写提出就业法庭申诉的时间限制，原文第四段明确指出“You must do this no more than three months after the time when the event... happened”，因此答案为数字“3”，表示三个月内。
questions.reason: 原文明确three months，符合题干。
questions.location_analysis: 原文规定三个月内提出，空格填数字3。
questions.paraphrasing: within 3 months -> no more than three months
evidence: You must do this no more than three months after the time when the event you are complaining about happened.

parts.source_article_title: Procedure for making a complaint at work

sentence_translations.sentence: If you have a problem or complaint at work, you might want to take this up with your employer.
sentence_translations.translation: 如果你在工作中遇到问题或提出投诉，你可能希望与雇主讨论此事。

sentence_translations.sentence: This is called 'raising a grievance'.
sentence_translations.translation: 这被称为“提出申诉”。

sentence_translations.sentence: Often the best way to sort out a problem is to request an informal meeting with your immediate manager to explain your concerns.
sentence_translations.translation: 通常，解决问题的最佳方式是请求与直属经理进行非正式会议，以解释你的担忧。

sentence_translations.sentence: You may find it is possible to sort the problem out in this way without having to take any further action.
sentence_translations.translation: 你可能会发现，通过这种方式解决问题是可行的，无需采取进一步行动。

sentence_translations.sentence: However, if you do not feel your problem has been solved, you may decide to raise a formal grievance.
sentence_translations.translation: 然而，如果你觉得问题没有得到解决，你可以决定提出正式申诉。

sentence_translations.sentence: In this case you should first try to find out your company's grievance procedure.
sentence_translations.translation: 在这种情况下，你应首先尝试了解公司的申诉程序。

sentence_translations.sentence: You should be able to find details of this in your Company Handbook, HR or Personnel manual, or on your company's HR intranet site.
sentence_translations.translation: 你应能在公司手册、人力资源或人事手册中，或是公司的人力资源内网上找到相关细节。

sentence_translations.sentence: The next step will probably be to write to your employer.
sentence_translations.translation: 下一步可能是写信给你的雇主。

sentence_translations.sentence: Explain your problem, and if you can think of a possible solution for resolving it, give details of this.
sentence_translations.translation: 解释你的问题，如果你能想到可能的解决方案，请详细说明。

sentence_translations.sentence: When you have written your letter, check that you have written the date, and retain a copy so that you have a record of what you wrote.
sentence_translations.translation: 写完信后，检查是否写上了日期，并保留一份副本，以便你有记录自己写的内容。

sentence_translations.sentence: Your employer should arrange an initial meeting at a reasonable time and place to discuss your grievance.
sentence_translations.translation: 你的雇主应安排一次初次会议，在合理的时间和地点讨论你的申诉。

sentence_translations.sentence: You are entitled to ask either a colleague from work or a trade union representative to go to the meeting with you.
sentence_translations.translation: 你有权邀请一位同事或工会代表与你一同参加会议。

sentence_translations.sentence: After the meeting, your employer should write to you, telling you what they have decided to do about your grievance.
sentence_translations.translation: 会议结束后，你的雇主应写信给你，告知他们针对你的申诉所做的决定。

sentence_translations.sentence: If you don't agree with your employer's decision, you have the right to appeal against it.
sentence_translations.translation: 如果您不同意雇主的决定，您有权对此提出申诉。

sentence_translations.sentence: This must be done in writing.
sentence_translations.translation: 这必须以书面形式进行。

sentence_translations.sentence: A further meeting should then be called, which should be led by a more senior manager if possible.
sentence_translations.translation: 随后应召集一次进一步的会议，如果可能的话，应由更高级别的经理主持。

sentence_translations.sentence: If you are still not satisfied with the decision made at this meeting, you may consider whether one way to solve the problem might be through mediation.
sentence_translations.translation: 如果您仍然对本次会议做出的决定不满意，您可以考虑通过调解来解决问题是否是一个途径。

sentence_translations.sentence: This may be done inside the company or by an external agent.
sentence_translations.translation: 这可以在公司内部进行，也可以通过外部机构进行。

sentence_translations.sentence: Alternatively, you can make an employment tribunal claim.
sentence_translations.translation: 或者，您可以向就业法庭提出索赔。

sentence_translations.sentence: You must do this no more than three months after the time when the event you are complaining about happened.
sentence_translations.translation: 您必须在所投诉事件发生后的三个月内提出。

sentence_translations.sentence: If your application is received after this time limit, the tribunal will not usually accept it.
sentence_translations.translation: 如果您的申请在此时间限制之后才被收到，法庭通常不会予以受理。

sentence_translations.sentence: Driving a taxi or private hire vehicle
sentence_translations.translation: 驾驶出租车或私人租用车辆

sentence_translations.sentence: Taxis are an important part of any town or city's transport system.
sentence_translations.translation: 出租车是任何城镇或城市交通系统的重要组成部分。

sentence_translations.sentence: Taxis have a licence plate and roof sign that states they are a taxi.
sentence_translations.translation: 出租车有牌照和顶灯，表明它们是出租车。

sentence_translations.sentence: As a taxi driver, you might be booked in advance, wait on a taxi rank or pick up passengers while on the move.
sentence_translations.translation: 作为一名出租车司机，你可能会被提前预订、在出租车站等候或在行驶中接载乘客。

sentence_translations.sentence: You could combine normal 'pick-up' jobs with prearranged contracts such as regular trips for schoolchildren or those unable to drive.
sentence_translations.translation: 你可以将常规的‘接载’工作与预先安排的合同（例如为学生或无法驾驶的人提供定期行程）结合起来。

sentence_translations.sentence: You might also make longer-distance trips such as taking people to airports.
sentence_translations.translation: 你也可能进行长途行程，例如送人们去机场。

sentence_translations.sentence: The other type of passenger transport is a private hire vehicle.
sentence_translations.translation: 另一种类型的客运是私人租赁车辆。

sentence_translations.sentence: As a private hire driver, you can only collect passengers who have pre-booked through your operator.
sentence_translations.translation: 作为一名私人租赁司机，你只能接载通过你的运营商预先预订的乘客。

sentence_translations.sentence: You cannot be flagged down in the street.
sentence_translations.translation: 你不能在街上被挥手拦车。

sentence_translations.sentence: When working in a taxi or private hire vehicle, you would:
sentence_translations.translation: 当您在出租车或私人租赁车辆中工作时，您将：

sentence_translations.sentence: • take job details over the radio from the operator at the office or by an in-car computer
sentence_translations.translation: • 通过办公室调度员的无线电或车载电脑接收工作详情

sentence_translations.sentence: • help to load and unload passengers' luggage
sentence_translations.translation: • 协助装卸乘客的行李

sentence_translations.sentence: • assist passengers with any physical conditions that make it difficult for them to get in and out of the vehicle
sentence_translations.translation: • 帮助那些因身体状况而难以进出车辆的乘客

sentence_translations.sentence: • take payments
sentence_translations.translation: • 收取费用

sentence_translations.sentence: • keep the vehicle clean and roadworthy
sentence_translations.translation: • 保持车辆清洁并处于适航状态

sentence_translations.sentence: • keep accounts and records, if self-employed.
sentence_translations.translation: • 如果你是个体经营者，需要保留账目和记录。

sentence_translations.sentence: Working conditions and skills
sentence_translations.translation: 工作条件与技能

sentence_translations.sentence: You would spend most of your time on the road, sometimes in heavy traffic, and you would be constantly on the move.
sentence_translations.translation: 大部分时间你都会在路上，有时会遭遇交通拥堵，并且你会持续处于移动状态。

sentence_translations.sentence: The job allows you to choose your hours, but you will find more work in the evenings.
sentence_translations.translation: 这份工作允许你自由选择工作时间，但你会发现晚上工作量更大。

sentence_translations.sentence: You would work between 40 and 60 hours a week if full time.
sentence_translations.translation: 如果全职工作，你每周需要工作40到60小时。

sentence_translations.sentence: In the UK,17% of taxi drivers are employed full time,17% are employed part time and 66% are self-employed.
sentence_translations.translation: 在英国，17%的出租车司机全职受雇，17%兼职受雇，而66%是自雇人士。

sentence_translations.sentence: As well as being a skilled driver, you need to be good at communicating with people and helping customers.
sentence_translations.translation: 除了是一名熟练的司机外，你还需要善于与人沟通并帮助顾客。

sentence_translations.sentence: You must be tactful when dealing with problems and have good time management and numeracy skills.
sentence_translations.translation: 处理问题时你必须机智得体，并具备良好的时间管理和计算能力。

sentence_translations.sentence: Requirements
sentence_translations.translation: 要求

sentence_translations.sentence: You will need a special licence from your local authority to be a taxi driver or private car hire driver.
sentence_translations.translation: 要成为一名出租车司机或私人租车司机，你需要从当地政府获得特殊执照。

sentence_translations.sentence: For this, you usually need to be over 21 years old, to have a clean current driving licence and to have been driving for at least 12 months.
sentence_translations.translation: 为此，你通常需要年满21周岁，持有有效的无违章记录驾驶执照，并且驾龄至少满12个月。

sentence_translations.sentence: You may also need to pass a test of knowledge about the local geography.
sentence_translations.translation: 你可能还需要通过一项关于当地地理知识的测试。

sentence_translations.sentence: If you are using your own vehicle, it will also need a special licence.
sentence_translations.translation: 如果你使用自己的车辆，它也需要获得特殊执照。

sentence_translations.sentence: Many employers value additional driver training which could include the Advanced Driving Test offered by the Institute of Advanced Motorists.
sentence_translations.translation: 许多雇主重视额外的驾驶员培训，这可能包括由高级驾驶员协会提供的进阶驾驶考试。

sentence_translations.sentence: Evidence of basic mechanical skills, such as RQF level 4, would also be welcome.
sentence_translations.translation: 具备基本机械技能的证据（例如 RQF 4 级资格）也将受到欢迎。

paragraphs.text: Rhubarb has large fan-shaped leaves and long, green edible stalks, which are commonly cooked with sugar to make pies and other desserts. One type of rhubarb is grown in the dark to produce longer, rosier stalks and this is called 'forced rhubarb'
paragraphs.translation:
大黄有巨大的扇形叶片和长而绿色的可食用茎秆，这些茎秆通常与糖一起烹饪，用来制作馅饼和其他甜点。
一种大黄在黑暗中生长，以产生更长、更粉红的茎秆，这被称为‘催熟大黄’。
标题：温室大黄

paragraphs.text: A

In the north of England, a cold winter is good news for some, and not just snowmen and woolly hat makers.According to Yorkshire farmer David Westwood, this year's forced rhubarb is the best for years. Westwood, a softly spoken Yorkshireman, should know.He's been growing and selling rhubarb for 62 years, since he started picking on the farm aged 11.His son Jonathan works on the farm too, making him the sixth generation of the Westwoods to grow the pink stems or 'petioles' as they are otherwise known.
paragraphs.translation:
在英格兰北部，寒冷的冬天对某些人来说是好消息，而不仅仅是雪人和羊毛帽制造商。
据约克郡农民大卫·韦斯特伍德称，今年的催熟大黄是多年来最好的。
韦斯特伍德，一个说话温和的约克郡人，理应了解这一点。
他从11岁开始在农场采摘大黄，至今已种植和销售大黄62年。
他的儿子乔纳森也在农场工作，使他成为韦斯特伍德家族种植粉色茎杆（或称为“叶柄”）的第六代传人。
标题：温室大黄

paragraphs.text: B

We meet at his farm, a few miles from the city of Wake field, which with the cities of Bradford and Leeds form the three points of the Rhubarb Triangle, the heart of the British rhubarb industry. 'It doesn't grow as well anywhere else,' insists Westwood.He has a number of theories as to why this is. The loam soil on a clay base is perfect for the roots or 'crowns' which rhubarb grows from. In Victorian times - the mid-to-late 1800s - when rhubarb's popularity was at its peak, the local coal mines provided cheap fuel for heating the sheds, a crucial part of the forcing process,which involves depriving the plants of light as they develop.At the same time, the effluence from the industry enriched the soil for farmers.On top of that, according to Westwood, the high levels of pollution in the air would have been ideal for the rhubarb, as 'rhubarb loves soot'.
paragraphs.translation:
我们在距离韦克菲尔德市几英里的他的农场见面，该农场与布拉德福德市和利兹市共同构成了大黄三角区的三个顶点，这里是英国大黄产业的核心区域。
“在其他地方，它长得没有这么好，”韦斯特伍德坚持说。
关于为什么会这样，他有多种理论。
黏土基层上的壤土非常适合大黄生长所需的根系或“根冠”。
在维多利亚时代（19世纪中后期），大黄的受欢迎程度达到顶峰时，当地煤矿为加热温室提供了廉价的燃料，这是催熟过程中的关键部分，该过程包括在植物生长期间剥夺光照。
同时，工业排放物使农民的土壤变得更加肥沃。
此外，根据韦斯特伍德的说法，空气中高浓度的污染对大黄来说也是理想的，因为“大黄喜欢煤烟”。

paragraphs.text: C

Westwood's farm produces both the greenish outdoor rhubarb, the kind that grows well in gardens all over the country, and the startlingly pink forced rhubarb. It's this that is the 'cream of the crop' , the upper class of the rhubarb family. Forced rhubarb is the one that's most likely to convert rhubarb-haters who've been traumatised by harshly flavoured school pies made from green overgrown outdoor stems. The slender magenta spears,with a sherbet-tangy flavour and delicate texture,are a far cry from that coarse, bitter stuff. It's also a rare local fruit (although technically a vegetable) at a time when imports dominate, and a welcome splash of colour in the drab winter months. No wonder chefs and food writers have fallen in love with forced rhubarb all over again. It's enjoying a remarkable renaissance, for only 20years ago it was in such decline that Westwood, one of the last 12 growers left from a peak of 200, was considering abandoning it.
paragraphs.translation:
韦斯特伍德的农场既生产淡绿色的户外大黄，这种大黄在全国各地的花园里都能很好地生长，也生产颜色惊人的粉红色催熟大黄。
正是后者才是“精华中的精华”，即大黄家族中的上品。
催熟大黄最有可能改变那些因学校用绿色过老的外茎制成的味道浓烈的馅饼而遭受创伤、厌恶大黄的人的想法。
细长的品红色茎秆，带有果汁汽水般的浓郁风味和细腻口感，与那种粗糙苦涩的东西截然不同。
在进口产品占据主导地位的时代，它也是一种稀有的本地水果（尽管严格来说是蔬菜），并且在单调的冬季月份里增添了一抹令人欣喜的色彩。
难怪厨师和美食作家再次爱上了催熟大黄。
韦斯特伍德的农场既生产淡绿色的户外大黄，这种大黄在全国各地的花园中都能良好生长，也生产令人惊艳的粉红色催熟大黄。
正是这种催熟大黄堪称“精品中的精品”，属于大黄家族的顶级品类。
催熟大黄最有可能改变那些因学校馅饼使用粗糙过熟的绿色户外茎干而留下心理阴影的大黄厌恶者。
这些纤细的紫红色茎干，带有果汁般的酸甜风味和细腻口感，与那种粗糙苦涩的东西截然不同。
在进口产品占据主导的时代，它也是一种稀有的本地水果（尽管严格来说是一种蔬菜），并且在沉闷的冬季里为人们带来一抹令人欣喜的色彩。
难怪厨师和美食作家们重新爱上了催熟大黄。
它正经历一场显著的复兴，因为在仅仅20年前，它曾如此衰落，以至于韦斯特伍德——从鼎盛时期的200名种植者减少到仅剩的12名之一——曾考虑放弃它。
标题：温室大黄

paragraphs.text: D

There are certainly simpler ways to grow food.First the plant roots, or crowns,are grown outside for more than two years.Then, at the start of their third winter,they are left in the ground until it is cold enough to break the crowns' dormancy.This is one of the factors that gives British rhubarb the edge over imports from the Netherlands, which arrive in the country a scene-stealing couple of weeks before the Yorkshire crop. To bring them to market that early, the Dutch crowns are fed with gibberellic acid, to replace the hormones naturally generated by a period of cold weather. Westwood is relaxed on the subject of the imported rhubarb,remarking only: 'It's good-looking all right, but the flavour's nowhere near.' Back in Yorkshire, sometime around the middle of November, the crowns are dug up,transferred to sheds with earthen floors, and watered in.The light is blocked out completely and the heating is turned on. In the warm and dark, the shoots appear so quickly that the buds can be heard gently popping. Within three weeks or so, the first round of picking, or ‘pulling' as it's known, can begin.
paragraphs.translation:
当然有更简单的种植食物的方法。
首先，植物的根茎，或称冠芽，在户外生长两年以上。
然后，在它们第三个冬天开始时，它们被留在地里，直到天气足够寒冷以打破冠芽的休眠状态。
这是英国大黄相比荷兰进口产品具有优势的因素之一——荷兰产品比约克郡的作物早到几周，颇为抢眼。
为了那么早上市，荷兰的冠芽被喂食赤霉酸，以替代由一段寒冷天气自然产生的激素。
韦斯特伍德对进口大黄的态度很放松，只评论道：‘它外表确实不错，但味道差远了。'
回到约克郡，大约在十一月中旬，冠芽被挖出，转移到有泥土地面的棚屋里，并浇水。
光线被完全遮挡，暖气被打开。
在温暖和黑暗中，嫩芽出现得如此之快，以至于能听到花蕾轻轻爆裂的声音。
大约在三周内，第一轮采摘，即所谓的“拉采”，就可以开始了。
首先，植物的根，即冠根，需要在户外生长两年多。
然后，在它们第三个冬季开始时，它们被留在土里，直到天气足够寒冷，可以打破冠根的休眠期。
这是英国大黄相对于从荷兰进口的大黄具有优势的因素之一，后者会比约克郡的作物提前几周抵达该国，抢尽风头。
为了这么早就投放市场，荷兰的冠根被施用了赤霉酸，以替代由一段寒冷天气自然产生的激素。
韦斯特伍德对进口大黄这个话题态度轻松，只评论道：‘它看起来确实不错，但味道差远了。’
回到约克郡，大约在11月中旬，冠根被挖出，转移到有泥土地面的棚屋里，并浇水。
在温暖和黑暗的环境中，嫩芽出现得如此之快，以至于可以听到花蕾轻轻爆裂的声音。
大约在三周内，第一轮采摘，也就是所谓的“拉取”，就可以开始了。

paragraphs.text: E

In Westwood's 1920s rhubarb sheds, it is pitch black. l slip and slide on the narrow troughs that serve as paths between the beds of rhubarb crowns. It's a relief when a team of 'pullers' arrive, all local men, some of whom have been working for Westwood for 40 years. Each carries a sturdy candle, and their pale, flickering light reveals a sea of yellow leaves stretching 40 metres to the far wall. The men walk the beds plucking the satiny stems expertly, choosing only the ones that have reached the length of an arm.Then, cradling the fuchsia pink bundles in their arms, they move on to the next patch. It's an extraordinary sight in this age of mechanised, computerised agriculture.'The pulling's done much the same way as it always has been,' Westwood says.'Electric light spoils the colour.' A labour-intensive process, it goes some way to explain the admittedly eye-watering price of the best forced rhubarb - that and the heating, now from oil or propane rather than coal.
paragraphs.translation:
标题：温室大黄
我在充当大黄根茎苗床之间通道的狭窄沟槽上打滑。
当一队“采收工”到来时，我感到松了一口气，他们都是当地人，有些人已经为韦斯特伍德工作了40年。
每人拿着一根结实的蜡烛，他们苍白、摇曳的灯光映出一片黄色叶子的海洋，延伸40米直至远处的墙壁。
这些人在苗床间行走，熟练地采摘柔滑的茎，只挑选那些已经长到手臂长度的。
然后，他们怀抱紫粉色的束捆，继续走向下一片区域。
在这个机械化、计算机化的农业时代，这真是一个非凡的景象。
“采收的方式和以往差不多，”韦斯特伍德说。
“电灯会破坏颜色。”
这个劳动密集型的过程，在一定程度上解释了最佳温室大黄那公认令人瞠目的价格——还有取暖费用，现在使用油或丙烷代替了煤炭。
在韦斯特伍德建于20世纪20年代的大黄种植棚里，一片漆黑。
我在充当大黄根茎苗床之间通道的狭窄沟槽上滑来滑去。
当一队“采收工”到来时，我感到如释重负，他们都是当地人，其中一些人已经为韦斯特伍德工作了40年。
每个人带着一根结实的蜡烛，他们苍白摇曳的烛光映出一片黄色的叶子海洋，绵延40米直至远处的墙壁。
这些人在苗床间行走，熟练地采摘光滑的茎秆，只选择那些长到手臂长度的。

sentence_translations.translation: 那么，这种自维多利亚时代沿用至今的奇妙冷暗热过程是如何被发现的呢？

sentence_translations.sentence: Westwood's story is appealingly earthy.
sentence_translations.translation: 韦斯特伍德的故事朴实而引人入胜。

sentence_translations.sentence: A gardener threw an old crown onto the horse stable muck pile.
sentence_translations.translation: 一位园丁将一根老根茎扔到了马厩的粪堆上。

sentence_translations.sentence: The manure was hot, and the plant was soon covered.
sentence_translations.translation: 粪肥很热，植物很快被覆盖住了。

sentence_translations.sentence: The stable boy must have been puzzled by the startling pink spears that came pushing through the dirt a week or two later, but happily he had the good sense to gather them.
sentence_translations.translation: 一两周后，马厩男孩看到惊人的粉色嫩芽从土中钻出，一定感到困惑，但幸运的是，他明智地将它们收集了起来。

sentence_translations.sentence: Where there's muck there's money -and good eating indeed.
sentence_translations.translation: 粪堆生财——而且确实美味可口。
